mapper.sql: id, pool_code, name, model_type, selection_strategy, status, remark
mapper.select:
select from kb_model_pools
and is_deleted = 0
and ( pool_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or remark like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and model_type in
#{type}
order by id desc
select from kb_model_pools where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
select from kb_model_pools where pool_code = #{poolCode} and is_deleted = 0

select count(1) from kb_model_pools where pool_code = #{poolCode} and is_deleted = 0
and id != #{excludeId}
mapper.insert: insert into kb_model_pools(pool_code, name, model_type, selection_strategy, status, remark) values(#{poolCode}, #{name}, #{modelType}, #{selectionStrategy}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update kb_model_pools set pool_code = #{poolCode}, name = #{name}, model_type = #{modelType}, selection_strategy = #{selectionStrategy}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.delete: delete from kb_model_pools where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: select mpi.id, mpi.pool_code, mpi.model_code, mpi.weight, mpi.priority, mpi.status, m.model_code, (select lm2.model_name from kb_provider_model_mappings pm2 join kb_logical_models lm2 on lm2.model_code = pm2.logical_model_code where pm2.model_id = m.id order by pm2.id asc limit 1) as model_name, (select lm2.model_type from kb_provider_model_mappings pm2 join kb_logical_models lm2 on lm2.model_code = pm2.logical_model_code where pm2.model_id = m.id order by pm2.id asc limit 1) as model_type, m.provider_account_code, p.name as provider_name from kb_model_pool_items mpi inner join kb_models m on mpi.model_code = m.model_code left join kb_provider_accounts pa on m.provider_account_code = pa.code left join kb_providers p on pa.provider_code = p.code where mpi.pool_code = #{poolCode} order by mpi.priority asc, mpi.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into kb_model_pool_items(pool_code, model_code, weight, priority, status) values(#{poolCode}, #{modelCode}, #{weight}, #{priority}, #{status})
mapper.update: update kb_model_pools set is_deleted = 1 where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: select count(1) from kb_routing_rule_targets where target_type = 'MODEL_POOL' and target_id = #{poolId}
